fathers.line: Welcome to the land of our fathers
stanza: Welcome to the land of our fathers
In the land of our fathers
They dance with the invisible ones
They dance alone... they dance alone

fathers.line: Like our brothers speaking loud like our fathers
stanza: It is loud, it is clear
It's for calling out the wrong
From the mouths of our mothers
To the lips of our daughters
Like our brothers speaking loud like our fathers

fathers.line: Remember those who lost their mothers and fathers
stanza: Remember those who lost their mothers and fathers
And make sure that every single moment that you have with them

fathers.line: See – he’s less the tights and garters – more the sons demanding answers from t…
stanza: See – he’s less the tights and garters – more the sons demanding answers from t…
The hot darkness of your last embrace.
He’s in the laughter of the night before, the tightened jaw of the morning afte…
He’s in us. Part and parcel of our Royals and our rascals.
He’s more than something taught in classrooms, in language that’s hard to under…
he’s more than a feeling of inadequacy when we sit for our exams,
He’s in every wise woman, every pitiful villain,
Every great king, every sore loser, every fake tear,
His legacy exists in the life that lives in everything he’s written,
And me, I see him everywhere, he’s my Shakespeare.
